row.evidence: Gladly's SSO docs offer SAML 2.0 with JIT user creation ("JIT provisioning is currently only available through Okta and PingOne"); no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or the REST API reference.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only: no public plans (gladly.ai/pricing redirects to the homepage; sales via the contact form); billing is by contracted seats or user months with usage-based true-ups, so price fields stay null and sso_plan is null (SAML is documented with no plan gate). No SCIM; SAML JIT creates users on first login for Okta and PingOne only, with role and inbox mapping from SAML attributes; deactivation is manual (users cannot be deleted). CSV bulk import/edit exists. The REST API only reads agents and teams. Okta OIN search returns no Gladly app; vendor guides use custom SAML apps for Okta, Entra, Google and OneLogin.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented in the help-centre index (llms.txt), the SSO guides or the REST API reference; SAML JIT (Okta and PingOne only) is the only automated provisioning. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Token-based Basic Authentication: agent email as user name, API token as password; requires the API User permission.

capabilities.notes: The Agents and Teams resources are read-only lookups (plus a call-recorder setting per agent); no create, update or deactivate endpoint for users is documented.

audit_log_api.notes: An Audit Log report exists in the UI; no audit-log API endpoint was found in the REST reference.

rate_limits.text: Default 10 requests per second per method (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE); 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: No user create, update or deactivate endpoints in the REST API; users are managed in the UI or by CSV.

okta.notes: No OIN app; vendor guide creates a custom Okta SAML 2.0 app (JIT supported for Okta).

entra.notes: Vendor guide adds a non-gallery Entra application for SAML.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per vendor guide.

onelogin.notes: SAML Custom Connector per vendor guide; OneLogin catalogue not loaded.
